title: Decision of the EEA Joint Committee No 100/2026 of 20 March 2026 amending Annex XIII (Transport) to the EEA Agreement [2026/1247]
text:
Official Journal of the European Union
EN
L series
2026/1247
25.6.2026
DECISION OF THE EEA JOINT COMMITTEE No 100/2026
of 20 March 2026
amending Annex XIII (Transport) to the EEA Agreement [2026/1247]
THE EEA JOINT COMMITTEE,
Having regard to the Agreement on the European Economic Area (“the EEA Agreement”), and in particular Article 98 thereof,
Whereas:
(1)
Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2143 of 23 October 2025 amending Regulation (EU) 2015/340 as regards the introduction of competency-based training and assessment and virtual training of air traffic controllers  ( 1 ) is to be incorporated into the EEA Agreement.
(2)
Annex XIII to the EEA Agreement should therefore be amended accordingly,
HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
Article 1
The following indent is added in point 66nj (Commission Regulation (EU) 2015/340) of Annex XIII to the EEA Agreement:
‘—
32025 R 2143 : Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2143 of 23 October 2025 ( OJ L, 2025/2143, 24.10.2025 ).’
Article 2
The text of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2143 in the Icelandic and Norwegian languages, to be published in the EEA Supplement to the Official Journal of the European Union , shall be authentic.
Article 3
This Decision shall enter into force on 21 March 2026, provided that all the notifications under Article 103(1) of the EEA Agreement have been made  ( *1 ) .
Article 4
This Decision shall be published in the EEA Section of, and in the EEA Supplement to, the Official Journal of the European Union .
Done at Brussels, 20 March 2026.
For the EEA Joint Committee
The President
Nicolas VON LINGEN
( 1 )
OJ L, 2025/2143, 24.10.2025, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2025/2143/oj .
( *1 )   No constitutional requirements indicated.
